title: Kissed with Ice Syrian Chickpea Bowl
description: Tender chickpeas and sweet potatoes are poached and served with a refreshing scoop of rose water ice cream, making this a perfect comfort dish for a sick day.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the chickpeas, sweet potatoes, onion, and garlic.
Add enough water to the saucepan to cover the ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and let the mixture simmer for 15 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Strain the chickpea mixture and discard the liquid.
Return the saucepan to the stovetop over medium heat and add the rose water, if using.
Stir well to combine and let the mixture cook for 1-2 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
To serve, divide the chickpea mixture among four bowls and top each bowl with a scoop of ice cream.
Sprinkle the ice cream with salt and black pepper to taste, if desired.
